provenance: v1-v5 are open AI-authored synthetic data. Root used v5 errors while developing v1.8. No fresh blind corpus, real posts or human annotation.

challenge-v1.dataset: challenge-v1: OPEN DEVELOPMENT. Texts and AI labels were available during v1.8 development.
challenge-v1.positiveDefinition: high: observed prize + mandatory entry payment + random selection, without unresolved contradiction
limitations: Synthetic textual scenarios; class prevalence and wording are designed.
Medium cases count as not-high for strict binary metrics; queue metrics use high + medium vs low.
Text metrics exclude OCR, ASR, platform access and human analyst performance.

evidenceValidation.scope: Main campaigns and their single-source baseline calls; exact original UTF-16 offsets.

limitations: All reported v1.8 accuracy figures use development data already available to the developer.
A zero observed high FPR on development examples does not mean zero real errors.
The previous v1.7 blind result is preserved unchanged and does not measure v1.8.
The priority score is not a probability of fraud or a legal determination.
Hypothetical labels and class prevalence are AI-authored; no representative production estimates.
